caseName: Holley v. General American Life Insurance Co.
caseNameFull: Holley v. General American Life Insurance Co.
attorneys: Mr. Chelsea O. Inman for petitioner. Messrs. Fred L. Williams, Earl F. Nelson, and Allen May for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion to substitute Ray B. Lucas, present Superintendent of the Insurance Department of the State of Missouri, as a party respondent in the place and stead of George A. S. Robertson, deceased, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.
